Use when users need a data model, DDL, an ERD-ready table list, an embed-or-reference decision, a schema review, or a safe migration plan, even if they only describe entities and queries or a symptom such as re-signup failing after soft delete, cross-tenant data leaking, or a migration that locked production. Not for REST or GraphQL API models, ORM classes for an existing schema, data-warehouse dashboards, database deployment, backups or connection pooling, or tuning a query without changing the schema.
